newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks plummet more than four percent.
newsitem.headline: French stocks plummet more than four percent.

text.p: French stocks plummeted in early afternoon trading on Wednesday on talk that privately commissioned polls show the Socialists winning a majority of the parliamentary seats in Sunday's runoff election, brokers said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 108.22 points, or 4.04 percent, at 2,572.12 at 1035 GMT after falling through several support levels. It hit a session low of 2,566.77.
The May CAC-40 futures contract was down 108 points at 2,570.
Traders said investors are trying to fully price in the impact of a Socialist victory on Sunday.

Although expectations are broadly that the Socialists would not scupper the policies relating to budget discipline and the drive to European monetary union, share analysts have estimated the CAC could fall to 2,450-2,500 points if they won on Sunday.
However, market operators noted that if the Socialists do win an outright majority, they would not need to rely on the Communists for votes and would be able to pursue more centrist policies.
The CAC-40 May futures contract was briefly suspended after falling 120 points. It was off its lows at 2,587, down 91 points at 1105 GMT.
The CAC index was down 90.58 percent, or 3.37 percent, at 2,590.02. All CAC 40 issues were down.
